resources.string: An optional DISCIPLINE OS mode. This service reads only the package name of the app that comes to the foreground, so it can show a reminder screen when you open an app you chose to limit while your mandatory tasks are still open. It does not read screen content, type or tap on your behalf, and no information is stored or sent off the device. You can turn it off here at any time.

DISCIPLINE OS can use the Android Accessibility Service to detect more quickly which app was opened.

What is read: only the package name (for example com.example.app) of a window that comes to the foreground, via the TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED event.

What is not read or done: we do not read text, images or any other content on the screen, and we do not type, tap or take any action on your behalf.

Where the data goes: nowhere. The package name is checked in memory against the list of apps you selected and discarded immediately. It is not stored, sent or shared.

Why: to show the reminder screen when you open an app you chose to limit while your mandatory tasks are open.

This is optional: the default mode (Usage access + Display over other apps) works without the Accessibility Service. You can turn it off at any time in your device settings or here.

A safety net: pauses all enforcement for as long as you choose. Always available, no questions asked.
What the limiter can and can\'t do

The limiter detects which app is open and shows a reminder screen. There is no absolute blocking: there may be a delay of up to about one second, device makers may stop it to save battery, and you can always revoke permissions, turn it off or uninstall the app. It will never limit the phone, emergency, messaging, settings or the home screen.
Every permission is explained. You can revoke any of them at any time in your device settings – the app keeps working, just without the limiter.
Required. Lets the app know which app is currently open, so a reminder appears only when you open an app you selected. The data stays on your device.
Required on Android 10 and later to show the reminder screen over the limited app. Without it, we show a notification instead.
Recommended. Shows the ongoing notification that the limiter is active, plus task reminders.
Recommended. Keeps the system from stopping the limiter in the background. The limiter saves battery on its own: it doesn\'t check while the screen is off or when there\'s nothing to limit.
On the next screen: choose \"All apps\", find DISCIPLINE OS and select \"Don\'t optimize\".
Optional. Instantly detects the foreground app – reads only the package name. Available only after a disclosure and your consent.
Optional. Lets the focus timer end exactly on time. Without it, the end may be slightly delayed.

• Settings → Apps → DISCIPLINE OS → Battery → "Unrestricted".
